subject: Decision path & milestone roll-up for NuvoHealth POC
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
To: Meera Rao <mrao@nuvohealth.com>, Tom Ellis <t.ellis@nuvohealth.com>
Cc: 
Date: Sun, 2 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Decision path & milestone roll-up for NuvoHealth POC

Hi Meera/Tom,

Thanks for the time on Friday — quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment.

Key takeaways:
- Use case: automated clinical note summarization for payer-submission prep.
- Decision criteria: latency under 400ms p95, redaction controls, SOC2 evidence, cost per 1k tokens target <$0.60.
- Stakeholders: Tom (product/exec sponsor), Meera (security), procurement (pricing/contract), Dana (finance/econ buyer?) — please confirm.

Proposed MAP (attached: Nuvo_MAP_v1.xlsx):
1) Technical POC (2 weeks) — Redwood demo + infra checklist — owner: Jasmine/Dev
2) Security review (3 weeks) — provide SOC2 + configured data-flow diagram — owner: Meera/Redwood security
3) Commercial review & T&Cs (1–2 weeks parallel to sec review) — owner: Procurement/Redwood sales
4) Pilot approval & capacity planning (1 week)

Ask:
- Confirm stakeholder list and target dates.
- Can procurement/finance review the commercial section by May 12?
- Security: which artifacts are required beyond SOC2? (Meera, tagging you)

Attachments referenced: Nuvo_MAP_v1.xlsx (draft MAP)

Thanks — I’ll circulate an updated MAP after your notes.

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Senior AE, Redwood Inference
jasmine.liu@redwood.com
(415) 555-0132

To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
Cc: Meera Rao <mrao@nuvohealth.com>, procurement@nuvohealth.com
Date: Sun, 2 May 2027 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Decision path & milestone roll-up for NuvoHealth POC

Thanks Jasmine — solid recap.

A couple notes:
- Dana Brooks (dana.brooks@nuvohealth.com) is the economic buyer; looping her on procurement timing.
- Security will need data-retention and encryption details; Meera will lead.
- Can we shift the Technical POC start to May 10 to give our infra team time?

Tom
VP Product, NuvoHealth
From: Meera Rao <mrao@nuvohealth.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>, Tom Ellis <t.ellis@nuvohealth.com>
Cc: legal@nuvohealth.com
Date: Mon, 3 May 2027 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Decision path & milestone roll-up for NuvoHealth POC

Jasmine,

Thanks — please send your most recent SOC2 report and a short data-flow diagram showing where PHI (if any) touches the system. Procurement will want a privacy addendum if PHI is in scope.

Security timeline: we need artifacts by May 13 to stay on the proposed cadence.

If you can share SOC2 and a sample redaction policy by EOD Wed (May 5) that would help.

-Meera
Director, IT Security
NuvoHealth
From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 3 May 2027 11:36:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Decision path & milestone roll-up for NuvoHealth POC — technical notes

Jasmine/Sean,

Quick update I drafted to respond to Meera and to update the MAP:
- I will own the infra checklist and host the demo on May 10. ETA: pre-demo test cluster by May 9.
- SOC2: we can provide the SOC2 Type II report and a short evidence packet — attaching 'technical-checklist.pdf' stub.
- Data handling: we will provide a data-flow diagram and sample redaction config. No PHI will be stored persistently in the POC; we can configure ephemeral KV caching and encryption at rest.
- Resource ask: Nuvo to provide a sandbox dataset (PII redacted) and an account with limited S3 access by May 7.

I updated the MAP draft with owners and revised dates — will push a version to Jasmine to attach.

Cheers,
Dev Patel
Solutions Engineer, Redwood
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
To: Meera Rao <mrao@nuvohealth.com>, Tom Ellis <t.ellis@nuvohealth.com>, Dana Brooks <dana.brooks@nuvohealth.com>, procurement@nuvohealth.com
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@sean.gallagher@redwood.com>, legal@nuvohealth.com
Date: Tue, 4 May 2027 16:22:00 -0700
Subject: Updated MAP & ask: sign-off on milestones

Folks,

Thanks for the quick responses. Attached is the revised MAP (Nuvo_MAP_v1.xlsx) and technical checklist (technical-checklist.pdf). Highlights:
- POC kickoff: May 10 — Redwood demo + infra test (owner: Dev)
- Security artifacts due: May 5 (SOC2 report, redaction policy) — (owner: Jasmine/Dev for delivery; Meera to confirm sufficiency)
- Procurement review (commercial terms): target May 12 — Dana/procurement
- Final pilot approval window: week of May 17

Please reply with 'Accept' or 'Need changes' on the MAP by EOD May 6. If 'Need changes,' call out which milestone and who should own the revision.

Attachments: Nuvo_MAP_v1.xlsx, technical-checklist.pdf, SOC2-evidence-request.pdf (requested by Meera)

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Senior AE, Redwood Inference
